questions.stem: One ____ of the students in our school come from the countryside.

options.distractor: 分子是 one，分母不加 s

questions.explanation: 三分之一 → one third（分子为 1，分母不加 s）。

questions.stem: About seventy ____ of the surface of the earth is water.

options.distractor: percentage 是“百分比”这个名词

questions.explanation: 百分数用 percent，永远不加 s。

questions.stem: Three fifths of the books ____ sold out already.

options.distractor: of 后 books 是复数

questions.explanation: of 后是复数 books → 谓语用 have been。

questions.stem: Nine twelfths of the food ____ gone bad.

options.distractor: food 不可数，谓语用单数
food 不可数，谓语用单数

questions.explanation: food 不可数 → 谓语用 has。

options.text: One third of the water is dirty.
Two fifths of the boys like football.
Three fourth of the teachers are women.
A quarter of the students are absent.

questions.explanation: 分子 three 大于 1，分母要加 s：three fourths（或 three quarters）。

questions.stem: — ____ of the workers in the factory are women? — About 40%.

options.distractor: 答语是百分比，问比例用 what 或 how much
表达累赘，通常用 what percent
